## `client.types`

{class}`~plone_client.managers.types.TypesManager`.

Content types and their JSON schemas (`@types`).

### `client.types.list`

Content types, with whether they can be added in a folder.

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.types.TypesManager.list`.

Calls `GET /news/@types` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/types.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.types.list("/news")
```
````

````{tab-item} Command line
:sync: cli

```shell
plone-client types --addable-in /news -c
```

```json
["Event", "File", "Image", "Link", "News Item", "Document"]
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
GET /Plone/++api++/news/@types HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=
```

```shell
curl -i -X GET http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/news/@types -H 'accept: application/json' -u admin:admin
```
````
`````

```json
[
  {
    "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/@types/Collection",
    "addable": false,
    "title": "Collection"
  },
  {
    "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/@types/Event",
    "addable": true,
    "title": "Event"
  },
  {
    "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/@types/File",
    "addable": true,
    "title": "File"
  }
]
```

This shows only `@id`, `title`, `addable` of each entry. This shows 3 of 8 entries.

### `client.types.create_field`

Add a field (or, with `fieldset` data, a fieldset) to a type.

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.types.TypesManager.create_field`.

Calls `POST /@types/sample` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/types.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.types.create_field(
    "sample",
    {"factory": "Text line (String)", "title": "Short name", "required": False},
)
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
POST /Plone/++api++/@types/sample HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=

{
  "factory": "Text line (String)",
  "title": "Short name",
  "required": false
}
```

```shell
curl -i -X POST http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/@types/sample -H 'accept: application/json' -H 'content-type: application/json' -u admin:admin --data-raw '{"factory":"Text line (String)","title":"Short name","required":false}'
```
````
`````

```json

  "factory": "Text line (String)",
  "title": "Short name"
}
```

This shows only `title`, `factory`.

### `client.types.update`

Change a type's schema, or one of its fields or fieldsets.

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.types.TypesManager.update`.

Calls `PATCH /@types/sample/short_name` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/types.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.types.update("sample", {"title": "Nickname"}, name="short_name")
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
PATCH /Plone/++api++/@types/sample/short_name HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=

{
  "title": "Nickname"
}
```

```shell
curl -i -X PATCH http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/@types/sample/short_name -H 'accept: application/json' -H 'content-type: application/json' -u admin:admin --data-raw '{"title":"Nickname"}'
```
````
`````

The site answers `204`, and the method returns `None`.

### `client.types.replace`

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.types.TypesManager.replace`.

Calls `GET /@types/sample`, `PUT /@types/sample` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/types.html)).

## `client.block_types`
